sentences.en: I can't believe he renounced his U.S. citizenship.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信他会放弃他的美国公民身份。

sentences.en: There can be no daily democracy without daily citizenship.
sentences.zh: 没有日常的公民参与就没有真正的民主。

sentences.en: Sami couldn't get a good job because he couldn't get citizenship.
sentences.zh: 萨米找不到好工作，因为他还没有获得公民身份。

senses.zh: 公民的权利与义务;公民权;市民权公民(或市民)身份个人的品德表现
